name: REST API Endpoint Development
description: Builds REST API endpoints following the project's conventions. Creates route handlers, request/response types, and integrates with the existing routing system.
outputPattern: Route file at src/routes/{resource}.ts with typed handlers
systemPromptAddition:
## REST API Skill
- All routes under /api/v1/ prefix
- Use the existing route factory pattern
- Define request/response types with Zod
